$team..validate: newData.hasChildren(['name', 'score', 'answered', 'startedAt']) && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length <= 28 && newData.child('score').isNumber() && newData.child('score').val() >= 0 && newData.child('score').val() <= 100 && newData.child('answered').isNumber() && newData.child('answered').val() <= 10
